blocks.heading: Do the pointers work?
blocks.body:
**Validate and Check for Completeness** (from Maps Manager) asks: does every pointer still find a file, a picture, a name?

A page can be fine on its own and still missing from the book :  or named in the book and missing on disk.

lessons.title: Break a pointer, then fix it

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
You just met the idea. Now do the lab: Break a pointer, then fix it.

This lab can fail. Fail when: You never ran completeness, or you left a broken pointer, or you only validated one topic.

Expected: You saw a missing-file row and repaired it. Completeness is clean again.

blocks.lead: Walk the cards below, in order, to Break a pointer, then fix it.
blocks.intro: How to Break a pointer, then fix it. Walk the cards in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Break a pointer, then fix it
steps.body: This is the whole move. The next cards are the steps, in order.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: With flowers.ditamap as the root map, run Validate and Check for Completeness from Maps Manager.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Write how many problems it reported in oxygen-bootcamp-work/week3/day-18-before.txt.

image.alt: New document wizard in Oxygen XML Editor
image.caption: File > New. Pick a file type here. On day 1 you only need a blank project, not this wizard yet.
image.credit: Oxygen XML Editor User Guide, Syncro Soft

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: On purpose: change one pointer to a file name that does not exist. Run completeness again. Read the row.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Put the real file name back. Run completeness again. It should be clean (or back to the same count as before).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: Do not only validate the one page. The booklet check is the apple.

blocks.summary: You saw a missing-file row and repaired it. Completeness is clean again.

blocks.body: The lab is done. Prove it with the check. Use words from today only.

blocks.q: A page can be clean while the booklet is broken. How?
options: The page’s tags match, but the booklet still points at a missing file
blocks.why: Page check = this file. Booklet check = do the pointers work. You need both.
